subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

Nicholas Copernicus is famous for showing the world that the sun is the ________ of the universe in 1543 AD in Poland. He also noticed that some planets appeared to change directions when moving ________ the sky. Earlier astronomers believed in the phenomenon of retrograde motion but Copernicus saw it as ________ that earth orbited the sun like other planets did.
solution:
The correct answer is '**centre; across; proof**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the key contributions of Nicholas Copernicus to astronomy.
 
• The appropriate words should indicate the central position of the sun, the motion of planets, and the evidence supporting the heliocentric model.
 
• "**Centre**" fits as it denotes the central position of the sun, "**across**" fits describing the movement of planets, and "**proof**" fits as it refers to the evidence of the sun-centered theory.
